t: This is Handel Hendrix House in Mayfair, a museum covering two musicians who lived next door to each other on Brook Street. The German-born Baroque composer George Frideric Handel lived at number 25, and the American guitarist Jimi Hendrix at number 23. Handel is known for his operas, oratorios and concerti grossi. Hendrix is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential guitarists of all time. The museum was founded by Stanley Sadie, the musicologist who edited the sixth edition of the Grove Dictionary of Music and Musicians.
